# workbench

> Creates and configures the development machine: an Ubuntu virtual machine with the tools, sign-in, git
> hooks, the workspace and its updates, which you reach from your editor over SSH. Decided in ADR-0023,
> ADR-0026 and ADR-0028 of the handbook.

## Documentation
- [GitHub access](docs/github-access.md): How developers and agents sign in through the ByteLibrary Developer Access App, and how CI uses its own App

## Parts
- [The doctor](src/doctor/README.md): Checks the development machine and the workspace, and repairs what is safe to repair.
